title: Buenos Aires · Sierra de la Ventana Weekend
slogan: A 1244 km loop out of Azul fuel
story: A real weekend escape from the flat city grid. 1208 km round from Azul - plan on about 20 h 50 of riding. The stops in between: Sierra de la Ventana, Cerro Ventana view and Tornquist hills. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
